_comment: p1536 token counts on its tokenizer-training text, for G5's KAS unigram log-prior. Made by count_p1536.py; see README.md. `total[i]` is the raw count of id i summed over all sources (no mix factor, no smoothing, no eos). p1536_counts_by_source.json has each file's counts (id -> count, non-zero only) so other weightings can be built.
